conservation.help_by: Use reef-safe sunscreen; choose operators that don’t touch or kick coral.
conservation.caution_against: Never stand on, break, or collect living coral.

life_info.eating: Symbiotic algae plus plankton stung by tiny polyps. Looks like coral but is a hydrozoan relative of jellyfish.
life_info.mating: Releases medusae; also spreads by colony growth.
life_info.habitat: Shallow Aruba reef crests and flats — blade-like yellow-tan colonies in surge. Forms nursery structure for juvenile reef fish on Aruba’s leeward shallows.

fun_facts: Touching it feels like a bee sting — admire with eyes, not fingers.
Common on Aruba’s shallow reef islands alongside elkhorn stands.
